<b>The Wailing Mother</b> is a [[Grand Hunt Wishes|Grand Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, which is available on the [[Songclave]]'s Wishwall after entering the room in [[the Slab]] that contains the alcove to the [[Broodmother]] at least once, and also completing at least 5 Songclave Wishes, including [[Building Up Songclave]] and [[Strengthening Songclave]].

== Wish ==
[[File:Broodmother's Eye.png|link=Broodmother's Eye|left|thumb|100x100px]]

To complete the Wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must locate and slay [[Broodmother]], who lies within in [[the Slab]]. A small alcove opens up in the Slab, which Hornet can enter to find the Broodmother. Its location can be tracked by interacting with a trail of slime it leaves behind. Once defeated, Hornet can pluck the [[Broodmother's Eye]] from its corpse, producing a loud crunch.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Bell Shrine 06.png!Location of the Wishwall in Songclave
| Image2 = File:Mapshot SS Broodmother 01.png!Location of the Broodmother in the Slab
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Heavy Rosary Necklace.png|link=Heavy Rosary Necklace|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After slaying the Broodmother and turning in [[Broodmother's Eye|its eye]], Hornet is rewarded with a [[Heavy Rosary Necklace]], which can be broken into {{R|220}}.
